function.name: VarCySub
function.signature: HRESULT WINAPI VarCySub(CY cyLeft, CY cyRight, CY* pCyOut)
function.header_comment:
/************************************************************************
 * VarCySub (OLEAUT32.305)
 *
 * Subtract one CY from another.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  cyLeft  [I] Source
 *  cyRight [I] Value to subtract
 *  pCyOut  [O] Destination
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  Success: S_OK.
 *  Failure: DISP_E_OVERFLOW, if the value will not fit in the destination
 */
